verdicts.reason: A has a huge grey 'missing asset' placeholder box in the middle of the right column. Its text stack is cramped and misaligned, with a centred URL line under left-aligned copy. The RSVP CTA is reduced to one pill in a row of badges, and the logo is shrunk to a speck beside illegible legal text. B is cleaner, but the RSVP CTA is still buried among the badge pills in the top-right corner. 'Solstice Presents' sits below the body copy instead of above the headline, the headline is jammed against the right edge, and the legal text is unreadably tiny.

A demotes the RSVP CTA to a badge-sized pill in the top-right cluster and moves the 'Solstice Presents' eyebrow below the body copy. The headline crowds the right edge, and the legal text and the broken-asset mark are illegibly small. B has a large grey placeholder box on the right and shrinks the hero can to a tiny element. All four badges, including RSVP, are tiny pills at the bottom, the headline wraps onto two lines, and the eyebrow is again at the bottom.

A has a coherent two-column layout, but the RSVP CTA is buried as a badge in the top-right corner, the eyebrow is misplaced below the copy, and the legal text is unreadably small. B scatters the TASTINGS, RSVP, ALL AGES and FREE ENTRY pills at random spots across the canvas, with no alignment or grouping. Its tiny RSVP pill floats in the middle, and a broken placeholder image sits at the top centre.

A is structured but buries the CTA among the badges and puts 'Solstice Presents' in the wrong order. B moves the legal text to the top and leaves the badge pills and the tiny RSVP scattered randomly. The logo and the hero can shrink to specks at the bottom, a grey missing-asset box sits in the bottom left, and the headline spans the full width with no balance.
